japanese_evidence.summary: Official training material uses Japanese ReazonSpeech and published test assets include Japanese Common Voice, but no accepted liveconv Japanese quality result exists.

blocking_reasons: Select a reviewed MIT trainer graph revision, target artifact digest, and immutable product approval record.
Select an approved trained model directory and record a deterministic artifact digest.

code.notes: The implemented technical graph is the MIT Beatrice Trainer distribution, not the VST host.

weights.notes: The trainer card declares included pretrained models MIT; target artifacts still require authorization and a digest.

training_data.notes: Review ReazonSpeech conditions, LibriTTS-R, VocalSet, noise sources, and the target corpus separately.

inference_runtime.notes: The current adapter uses the trainer graph directly and explicitly excludes restricted beatrice.lib.

audio_contract.notes: The trainer graph supports the technical worker path, but a product sample-rate and context contract still require an immutable selected artifact.

target_preparation.procedure: Train or approve one target-specific paraphernalia model directory from authorized speech; the official material does not state a minimum duration.

artifact_env.purpose: Pinned MIT Beatrice Trainer graph and checkpoints

resource_budget_hypothesis.notes: Initial CPU-only inference envelope based on upstream claims, not a liveconv measurement; training resource needs are out of this runtime budget.

blockers.summary: Source revision and weight digest are not approved or pinned.
blockers.clear_when: A reviewed trainer revision, artifact SHA-256, and product approval record are recorded.

blockers.summary: Dependent training-data rights and conditions remain under review.
blockers.clear_when: The data chain and intended use are approved and recorded.

blockers.summary: No authorized target model directory has been selected.
blockers.clear_when: Authorized artifacts are produced, provenance-recorded, and digest-verified.

blockers.summary: Technical execution does not establish Japanese content preservation or an authorized-target quality result.
blockers.clear_when: Frozen Japanese content, authorized-target speaker, and audio-integrity gates pass for the selected product artifact.

adapter_conformance.criterion: Pass the common adapter contract through the MIT trainer graph without loading beatrice.lib.

warmup.criterion: CPU worker warmup reaches readiness within a frozen timeout.

cancel.criterion: Cancel prevents any later output from the canceled generation.

unload.criterion: Unload releases runtime state and repeated reload leaves the worker healthy.

vram.criterion: Confirm zero inference VRAM allocation and record peak and recovered CPU RAM.

stt.criterion: Japanese STT preservation and exact high-consequence entities pass the frozen rule.

speaker.criterion: Authorized-target similarity improves under the calibrated preregistered rule.

integrity.criterion: Finite samples, clipping, duration, silence, repetition, and discontinuity guardrails pass.

decision_notes: The MIT trainer graph can support technical execution without beatrice.lib, but target authorization, data and license review, immutable product approval, quality, and selection remain blocked.
